brief.zh: 链接电弧对僵尸造成伤害

description.en: Electric Currants create electrical fences between ones planted on the same row or column.
description.zh: 相同行或列的电流醋栗之间会产生电流线。

chat.en: "Electricity is all very well and fine as a phenomenon," says Electric Currant, "but electromagnetism as a whole is where it's really at."
chat.zh: “闪电永远是最棒的自然现象，”电流醋栗说道，“但是电磁学这个整体才是它的灵魂所在。”

text.en: knocks zombies back into other lanes when defeated
text.zh: 被打败时把僵尸击退至其他行
